                                                                                            Ian bee Custer Feldspar is a type of Potash Feldspar. If you click
    kenneth ibbett
   2 years ago                                                               on the material in the recipe, you will see under "Child Materials"
                                                                            a lot of different Potash Feldspars, including Custer. In fact, a lot
Very nice interesting glaze                                                                of US recipes imply Custer when they state Potash. There may
    Annie Lichter                                                             be slight variations between different types of Potash Feldspar,
   2 years ago                                                                       but usually they are not huge differences. I've never tried this
                                                                                             glaze, but it never hurts to try all your glazes in both normal
very pretty glaze!
                                                                                        cooling and slow cooling to see the difference. And to post the
